Short update from infra / on-call:

What we see:
- Spotty node restarts across two AZs in us-west2 over the last 20m; autoscaler triggered but some pods failing Liveness checks.
- KV cache eviction rate jumped ~6x; misses caused excess backend load and retries causing cascading timeouts.
- No global control-plane outage; this looks like a capacity/eviction cascade in USW2.

Immediate mitigations executed (09:00–09:10 PST):
- Enabled aggressive prefix/KV caching at the edge for ClearPath (reduced origin pulls).
- Removed a flaky node from the us-west2 pool and forced a soft drain for suspect pods.
- Enabled 503/502 circuit-breaker for high-error signaling at the routing layer to prevent retry storms.

Proposed temporary action (need approval from Jordan/Vanessa):
- Provisional steering: shift 60% of ClearPath traffic destined for USW2 -> USW1 for 30 minutes to reduce tail latency while we stabilize the USW2 pool.
- Keep 40% on USW2 for verification and to avoid warm-cache cold-start burst.

Attachments: support_bundle_20280110.tar.gz (logs + stack traces), usw2-kernel-logs.txt

Impact notes / risk:
- Reroute will introduce slight additional latency for rerouted requests (expected +40–80ms median) but should reduce error rates and overall dropped checkouts.
- If ClearPath has strict regional routing constraints, please confirm before steering.

Hannah
Sr. Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
